fields.summary_ko.0: Anthropic (ANT) opened at $111.50 (+34%) from $83 IPO price, showing strong initial demand, though patterns from SpaceX and Meta suggest potential weakness reversal after initial momentum.
fields.summary_ko.1: SpaceX rose to $211 in early June then declined approximately 50% at August lows, while Meta declined 40% from first-day levels after six months, though both have delivered strong earnings long-term.
